1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) that is __cytopathic__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

2. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus __derived from a strain distinct from those disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom; __wherein the BVDV-lb is cytopathic__.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof; __wherein the BVDV-lb is cytopathic__.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen; __wherein the at least a first antigen is an inactivated bacterial antigen__.

7. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof; __and wherein the antigen is derived from a bacterial strain not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated; __and wherein the inactivated antigen is derived from a bacterial pathogen not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen; __wherein the microbial pathogen-specific antigen is derived from a pathogen strain not disclosed in WO 2007/117303__.
